tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /bo dong lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jigs bral dgyes pa'i lam srol zhes
(kha)༄༅/ /bo dong lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jigs bral dgyes pa'i lam srol zhes

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// bo dong lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jigs bral dgyes pa'i lam srol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ sras bcas rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// rdo rje sgra dbyangs lha mo dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// zab mo'i gdams pa cung zad dbye// 'di la gsum/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ rjes gnang gi cho ga las sbyor gyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ skyabs sems tshogs bsags sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje srung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po kun nas 'khyil zhing nor bu sna tshogs kyis bltams pa'i dbus na/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ldem pa'i lte bar pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs chags pa ze'u 'bru dmar ser dri ngad phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal zhing dwangs pa'i gdan la/ hrīṃḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa la oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer tshad med gzhal du med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīṃ yig 'bru gsum dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje lha mo ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i rtsa phyag dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis kyi g.yon na rin po che'i rgyud mangs dku g.yon du brten nas 'dzin pa la/

g.yas pa'i sor mos dal gyis rdung zhing sgyur bas sangs rgyas thams cad kun nas mnyes te gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra snyan 'byung ba/ zhabs gnyis padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yab bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i rtsa phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis kyi g.yas na ral gri 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon na utpal sngon po shin tu gsal ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang sku blta bas chog mi shes pa la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer kun tu snang ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i shar gyi 'dam ma la shes rab ma/ lhor blo gros ma/ nub tu dran pa ma/ byang du yid gzhung ma ste de rnams thams cad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon pad dkar 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis kun nas spras shing yid du 'ong ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra swa ra swa tī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni// shes rab lha mo'i skur ston pa// dran pas blo gros mchog stsol ba'i// rdo rje dbyangs can ma la 'dud// ces bstod/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la hrīṃḥyig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/

de'i mthar sngags phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad 'od zer dang*/ hrīṃḥyig dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas/ rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīṃḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla/ thun mthar/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wardhā ni/ dzwa la dzwa la me dhā wardhā ni/ dhi ri dhi ri buddhi bardhā ni swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas la mchod cing bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar 'bul/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ zhes mang du bzlas la nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// bsnyen pa byed na rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag bdun dang*/ las sbyor gyi sngags de'i bcu cha tsam bzla/ 'di nyid bla med kyi phyogs su gtogs kyang kun spyod rgyud sde 'og ma ltar khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas par bya zhing*/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor sogs kyang dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sbyar la nyams su blang ngo*// ༈ /gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs maṇḍal gyi 'khor lo'i steng du 'bras dkar gyi phye ma'i tshab sindhū ra'i phye ma dar tshags la drangs pas mnan te 'khor lo'i ri mo dmar ser gsal bar bya/ gtor ma'ang dmar po mdzad pa phyag len du snang*/ gzhan 'dra/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun sgrub tshul lha sngags kyi khyad par ma gtogs cho ga'i chings dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skabs ji lta ba dang*/

rjes gnang gi tshe ras dkar po'i stod g.yogs sogs chas zhugs mi dgos/ gsung gi rjes gnang la bzlas lung spyi 'gre ltar mdzad/ gzhan lha sngags rje ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa las sbyor la gsum/ rdzas kyi sbyor ba dang*/ 'phrul 'khor dang*/ bum pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ rgyal phur 'grub sbyor sogs gza' skar shis pa'i nyin sindhū ra/ shu dag dkar po/ yur ba/ gi haṃ/ shing mngar rnams so sor zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma rin po che'i snod du dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu byas la spungs/ de rnams kyi steng du rdo rje dbyangs can ma gtso 'khor so sor gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sman gyi nyes skyon thams cad spungs/ nus pa mchog tu bskyed par bsams la rtsa sngags ci nus bzla/ mthar lha rnams 'od du zhu ba sman so so la bstim nas gcig tu bsres la sbrang rtsi dang*/ ba dmar mo dang*/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma bcas sbyar bas ril bur dril/ slar yang ril bu nyid lhar bskyed bstim bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skabs su bshad pa'i ril bu'i sngags rnams kyang ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa nyid tho rangs kyi dus su bsten pas bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang*/ thos pa 'dzin pa dang*/ smra mkhas shing dbyangs snyan pa sogs blo dang ngag gi dngos grub la dbang 'byor par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rig pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni/ rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas gro ga'am shog bu gtsang ma la gur gum dang*/ gi haṃ sbyar ba'i snag tshas 'khor lo mu khyud rim pa lnga lte ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su hrīṃḥ de'i mthar rtsa sngags dang las sngags kyi gsham du/ ma ma pradzñā dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes bri/ mu khyud dang po la padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su hrīṃḥ mthar shar du/ oṃ pradzñā swā hā/ lhor/ oṃ ma tī swā hā/ nub tu/ oṃ smṛ tī swā hā/

byang du/ oṃ pedhā swā hā/ zhes so so'i mthar spel tshig sbyar bas bskor/ gnyis pa la dbyangs/ gsum pa la gsal byed/ bzhi pa la rten snying rnams kyi mthar spel tshig sbyar ba ste/ thams cad g.yas skor du bkod/ lnga pa la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol du me 'bar bas khyab par 'bri'o// de nas sngags btab pa'i sindhū ra/ gur gum/ gi haṃ rnams kyis khyab par byugs/ yig 'bru rnams lha mo 'khor bcas dang*/ ming spel bsgrub byar gsal gdab la rab gnas spyi ltar byas mthar lha rnams yig 'bru dang*/ bsgrub bya'i ming spel du bsgyur la shis pa brjod/ gru bzhir lte ba ma nyams par bltab/ tshon skud sna lngas dkris la mgul lam dpung par btags na rig pa'i lha mos dus rtag tu byin gyis rlob cing*/ nad dang gnod pa las srung ba dang*/ phas rgol gyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i shes rab thob par 'gyur ro// gsum pa bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga ni/ bum rdzas nyer lnga/ bzang po drug sindhū ra rnams sbyar ba'i dri zhim po'i chus bum pa dgang la maṇḍal gyi dbus su bzhag gzhan yang mchod gtor sogs tshogs par bya/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ bum nang lha mo gtso 'khor lnga bskyed la cho ga spyi dang mthun pas zhag bdun sogs su thun du bcad la bsgrub/ mthar ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba'i chu bdud rtsir bsam la rang gzhan gyi don byas pas/ shes rab 'grib pa'i gegs sel dang*/ rno myur zab cing rgya che'i shes rab 'phel ba'i bogs 'don du 'gyur bar gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang sbyin sreg dang*/ gegs sel spogs chog sogs kyang dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skabs su bshad pa rnams 'dir yang sbyar du rung bar gsungs so// rdo ༵rje ༵dbyanga~Xs cana~X sgruba~X pa'i thaba~Xs// 'jiga~Xs brala~X slob dpon rab dgyesa~X pa'i~X// la~Xm srola~X bdud rtsi'i zla snang gis// sa gsum shis pa sbyin gyur cig

/ces pa'ang grub chen padma gar dbang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub rjes dang*/ las tshogs yig rnying thor bu las bshad pa ltar cho ga'i chings sbyar tshul sogs bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta bar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos nyung gsal snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis shar mar spel ba sarba sa twā wa gi shwa ra siddhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
